senses.definition: vb. grasp (Arabic عطو, عَطَا i, vii. take with hands);—

Inf. abs. + Pt. act. sf. וְעֹטְךָ עָטֹה Is 22:17 he shall grasp thee forcibly, cf. GesComm. Hi Ew De CheComm. Di GuKau; > Thes RobGes BuhlLex (13) from I. עטה (he shall wrap, roll the tight together); picked lice Je 43:12 (BöttNÄ 163 𝔊 cf. Is 22:17 Ct 1:7).
